basic_details.short_information: National University of Study and Research in Law, Ranchi (NUSRL Ranchi), Jharkhand, has invited applications for 5 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. NUSRL/RNC/2026/1060. Pay application fee of Rs. 1000/- online directly to the University's Bank Account and note the UTR/Transaction Reference Number.
Send the application along with all relevant self-attested supporting documents and CV via Indian Speed Post, Indian Registered Post, or Courier.

Superscribe the envelope with 'Post Applied For' and send to the Registrar, National University of Study and Research in Law Nagri, PO: Bukru, PS: Kanke Kanke-Pithoria Road, Kanke Ranchi (Jharkhand) – 834006.
Make sure it reaches by 6 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: NUSRL Ranchi Job Description
content_sections.text: Resident Warden Duties Ensuring the safety, security, discipline and well-being of students residing in the hostel. Maintaining regular interaction with students and addressing their academic, personal and residential concerns. Ensuring proper implementation of University rules, hostel regulations and code of conduct. Maintaining hostel attendance, student movement registers, visitor records and other relevant documentation. Monitoring hostel cleanliness, hygiene, maintenance, mess facilities and other residential amenities. Coordinating with the University administration, security personnel, maintenance staff and other concerned departments. Handling student grievances and facilitating their timely resolution. Providing immediate assistance in medical emergencies and other unforeseen situations. Informing the University administration and parents/guardians, wherever necessary, regarding serious matters concerning students. Preventing ragging, bullying, harassment, misconduct and any other activities affecting the safety and dignity of students. Ensuring compliance with applicable University policies and UGC regulations relating to student safety and anti-ragging. Organising and facilitating student engagement, recreational, cultural and other welfare activities. Preparing periodic reports regarding hostel administration and student welfare for submission to the competent University authorities. Performing any other duties assigned by the University administration from time to time. Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Responsibilities Take dictation and notes and later transcribe their notes into documents. Record minutes of meeting. Perform office task such as typing, filing, answering mails and operation Machine. Basic Knowledge of Accounts/ Administration/ Examination/ Establishment / HR will be advantages. Knowledge of File Management. Knowledge of Store Management.
